scripts.build:all: bun run --cwd packages/server build && bun run build:mcp
scripts.lint: bun --bun oxlint --type-aware --fix packages scripts tools/oxlint/standards apps/web/src apps/web/svelte.config.js apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.lint:check: bun --bun oxlint --type-aware packages scripts tools/oxlint/standards apps/web/src apps/web/svelte.config.js apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/vscode/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/vscode/tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/luau-bundler/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/luau-bundler/tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/oxlint/standards/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test --cwd packages/server && bun test --cwd packages/mcp && bun test --cwd packages/vscode && bun test --cwd packages/luau-bundler
scripts.build:bridge: bun packages/luau-bundler/src/cli.ts --src roblox/executor-bridge/src --out scripts/executor-bridge.lua --header 'rbxdev executor bridge'
